summary_hint: USCIS <form_type> <notice_type> (case <case_type>) for <beneficiary_name>, petitioner <petitioner_name>: <classification> valid <validity_from>–<validity_to>; notice dated <notice_date>.

typed_core.name: form_type
typed_core.why: ID-8 — which I-797 this is (I-797A carries an I-94 / status; I-797C is a receipt/action notice); shapes what the notice proves
typed_core.prompt_hint: I-797A / I-797B / I-797C, exactly as printed in the masthead

typed_core.name: notice_type
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the notice's own label (Approval Notice / Receipt Notice / etc.); a printed FACT, not a judgment
typed_core.prompt_hint: The 'Notice Type' as printed (e.g. 'Approval Notice'); do NOT infer eligibility or work authorization

typed_core.name: receipt_number
typed_core.why: identity — the USCIS case reference
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the receipt number VERBATIM (e.g. 'IOE0929461289'); it is masked at the snapshot boundary by the global PII registry — do not mask it here

typed_core.name: case_type
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the petition form (e.g. I-129 nonimmigrant worker); classifies what was filed
typed_core.prompt_hint: The case type as printed (e.g. 'I129 - Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker')

typed_core.name: received_date
typed_core.why: ID-8 — when USCIS received the petition (case timeline)

typed_core.name: notice_date
typed_core.why: ID-8 — recency of the notice evidence

typed_core.name: petitioner_name
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the sponsoring employer/petitioner (a work-classification notice sponsors employment)

typed_core.name: beneficiary_name
typed_core.why: ID-8 — WHOSE status this proves; match to the borrower (kept UNMASKED for name matching)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The beneficiary's full name, as printed ('LAST, FIRST' is fine)

typed_core.name: beneficiary_a_number
typed_core.why: PII + identity — the beneficiary's Alien Registration Number (A-number)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The A-number as printed (e.g. 'A220 831 209'); captured verbatim, masked + hashed at the snapshot boundary

typed_core.name: beneficiary_date_of_birth
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the borrower-match discriminator; kept UNMASKED (matching needs it; DOB is not a maskable PiiKind)

typed_core.name: beneficiary_country_of_citizenship
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the printed 'Country of Citizenship' on the I-94 block (residency/citizenship signal)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The 'Country of Citizenship' as printed — NOT country of birth (the form has no birth-country field)

typed_core.name: classification
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the immigration class the notice grants (e.g. H-1B); the work-authorization category

typed_core.name: validity_from
typed_core.why: ID-8 — start of the I-94 admission validity (the status window the person is authorized for)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The I-94 'VALID FROM' date (the tear-off I-94 block) — may differ from the petition validity by a grace period

typed_core.name: validity_to
typed_core.why: ID-8 — end of the I-94 admission validity (does status extend past the loan? the continuance test)

typed_core.name: petition_valid_from
typed_core.why: ID-8 — start of the petition/approval validity (the notice header 'Valid from'); distinct from the I-94 window
typed_core.prompt_hint: The 'Valid from' date under Notice Type — the PETITION validity, which may differ from the I-94 by a grace period

typed_core.name: petition_valid_to
typed_core.why: ID-8 — end of the petition/approval validity (the notice header 'to')

typed_core.name: i94_number
typed_core.why: PII + identity — the I-94 arrival/departure record number from the tear-off block
typed_core.prompt_hint: The I-94# as printed (e.g. '472830079 A3'); captured verbatim, masked + hashed at the snapshot boundary

typed_core.name: i94_class_of_admission
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the I-94 class of admission (corroborates classification)

typed_core.name: priority_date
typed_core.why: processor — the petition priority date, when printed (often blank on a nonimmigrant notice)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Only if a 'Priority Date' is printed; leave null when the field is blank

typed_core.name: service_center
typed_core.why: processor — the issuing USCIS service center (provenance)

rejected.name: is_eligible / work_authorized / status_valid
rejected.reason: JUDGMENTS, not facts — whether the beneficiary is eligible or currently work-authorized is ID-8's / the program's call. The notice itself states 'THIS NOTICE IS NOT A VISA'. Tags describe (form_type, class, validity dates); rules judge.

rejected.name: beneficiary_country_of_birth
rejected.reason: NOT on the form — the I-94 block prints 'Country of Citizenship', not country of birth. Renamed to beneficiary_country_of_citizenship (LP-461 lesson: capture what is printed).

rejected.name: beneficiary_address
rejected.reason: not reliably on the notice; the I-94 block carries name/DOB/citizenship, not a residence

rejected.name: signature_block / notary_block
rejected.reason: an agency-issued notice is not executed or notarized

encoding_variations: form_type — I-797A (carries the tear-off I-94 / grants status), I-797B (approval, consular — no I-94), I-797C (receipt/action); the I-94 block and validity fields are present only on I-797A

TWO validity ranges that genuinely differ: the notice-header 'Valid from ... to ...' (petition) and the I-94 'VALID FROM ... UNTIL ...' (admission) — the I-94 often extends a grace period past the petition end. Capture BOTH pairs; do not collapse them
notice_type — 'Approval Notice', 'Receipt Notice', 'Request for Evidence', etc.; degrade enum to str
case_type prints as 'I129 - PETITION FOR A NONIMMIGRANT WORKER' or just 'I-129'
the misroute risk: an I-797 is NOT a visa (it says so), NOT a green card, NOT an EAD card, NOT a passport — classification must route it here even when it concerns a work class (H-1B)

open_questions.q: notice_type — capture it or omit as too close to a judgment?
open_questions.recommendation: capture (GEET'S DECISION, LP-465): it is the document's OWN printed label, a fact, not our conclusion; is_eligible/work_authorized remain rejected
validity_*=the I-94 admission window (the status the person holds), petition_valid_*=the notice-header petition window — both printed and distinct on I-797A

notes: receipt_number is captured VERBATIM (full) and masked at the snapshot boundary by the EXISTING global _PII_FIELDS 'receipt_number' registration (a 10-digit run would otherwise trip the LP-209 at-rest guard). No new registry entry needed for it.

beneficiary_a_number and i94_number BOTH contain 9+ digit runs and MUST be routed through _PII_FIELDS or the at-rest guard fails — beneficiary_a_number is called out by LP-465; i94_number is an ADDITION found while reading 065 (the ticket did not flag it). Both registered (ACCOUNT, pre_masked=false) → masked + per-file match-hash (the A-number can then correlate to an EAD card's A-number).
beneficiary_name and beneficiary_date_of_birth stay UNMASKED — ID-8 matches the borrower on them; DOB is not a maskable PiiKind and its 8-digit run does not trip the guard.
No nested list — the notice is flat. All rule-relevant facts are scalars.
